messages:
hana: quick alert — after the 02:00 change window the canary to v6.2.1 shows p95 bump on /v1/generate, started ~02:03 UTC.
leo: saw deploybot: "rollout v6.2.1 canary=10% region=usw2 at 02:00". Any autorevert?
deploybot: auto-signal: p95 > threshold for 3m. Autorevert policy is warn-only for this window.
matt-ops: prefer manual intervention to preserve traces. Suggest soft unshift dedicated only 10->0 over 3m then pin v6.2.0 if stable.
hana: agree. Who can run traffic shift?
leo: I'll run: `rictl traffic shift --route /v1/generate --from v6.2.1 --to v6.2.0 --percent 10 --scope dedicated --duration 180s`
vivian-product: prepping a short customer blurb in case we pin. Keep it concise.
leo: shift started -> response: ok shifting 10->0 over 180s (dedicated).
deploybot: update: canary at 7%.
(2m)
matt-ops: metrics improving as canary drains; CPU normalizing. Pinning now: `rictl pin version --service generator --version v6.2.0 --scope dedicated --note "soft rewind 02:06 UTC"` -> ok pinned.
hana: created rollback PR to revert canary manifests (WIP).
leo: collecting traces for 20m; initial sign of kernel fallback + kv cache misses.
vivian-product: customer blurb drafted.
hana: decision: manual soft rewind executed; dedicated pinned for 24h pending RCA. Owners: leo=traffic+traces, matt-ops=pin+PR, vivian-product=comm. If metrics regress we'll escalate to hard revert.
leo: noted, posting early trace summary in ~10m.
deploybot: canary drained to 0% for dedicated; rollout halted.
(30m later)
leo: summary: kernel selection regression on long contexts causing increased per-token CPU; draft RCA to follow. Closing immediate thread.
